response_text: Kindful was acquired by Bloomerang in 2021. Since then, Kindful's features and functionalities have been integrated into the Bloomerang platform. Bloomerang aims to offer comprehensive donor management and fundraising solutions by combining the strengths of both platforms. Consequently, organizations using Kindful can transition to Bloomerang for an enhanced suite of tools designed to improve their fundraising efforts and donor management processes. If you are a Kindful user, it would be beneficial to check directly with Bloomerang for the latest updates on how the integration impacts your usage and what new features might be available to you.
